item.title: Teachers Negotiations Resume, Fake Gun Arrest, Top Model Win
item.ns0:title: Teachers Negotiations Resume, Fake Gun Arrest, Top Model Win
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, industrial tensions show signs of cooling as the government and the Bahamas Union of Teachers prepare to head back to the negotiating table. We investigate a fatal afternoon shooting in Chippingham that has pushed the national murder count higher and hear from a veteran aviation expert on the urgent need for enhanced safety oversight in Family Island travel. Our team also celebrates a historic week for Bahamian excellence, featuring a teen’s international pageant victory and a dominant performance on the WNBA All-Star stage. Join us for these headlines and a special look at how a piece of Bahamian sports history was saved from the scrap heap.
